 Football
 Soccer-Real Madrid defeat Barcelona at Camp Nou to halve gap to LaLiga leaders
 By Ruairidh Barlow 
 Monday, 26 Oct 2026
 | 6:19 AM MYT
 share 
 bookmark 
 Soccer Football - LaLiga - FC Barcelona v Real Madrid - Spotify Camp Nou, Barcelona, Spain - October 25, 2026 Real Madrid's Kylian Mbappe celebrates scoring their first goal REUTERS/Albert Gea 
 BARCELONA, Oct 25 (Reuters) - Real Madrid ⁠became the first side to beat ‌Barcelona in LaLiga this season, defeating the leagueleaders 2-1 at Camp Nou with ​a brace from Kylian ⁠Mbappe.
 The deadlock was ⁠broken in the 41st minute when Mbappe ⁠deflected ‌Gerard Martin's clearance into the net from close ⁠range.
 In the 61st minute, a quick ​corner ‌from Barcelona allowed Pedri to find ⁠Raphinha ​in space in the box. Andriy Lunin could not stop his shot ⁠from finding the corner.
 With ​three minutes remaining, Eduardo Camavinga broke in behind the Barcelona defence and ⁠laid the ball across forMbappe to score his second into an open goal.
 Barcelona remain atop LaLiga with ​27 points from ⁠10 games, one ahead of Atletico ​Madrid in second ‌place. Third-place Real Madrid ​are on 24 points.
 (Reporting by Ruairidh BarlowEditing by Christian Radnedge)
